sources.title: [2605.23993] Nano World Models: A Minimalist Implementation of Future ...
sources.snippet: We introduce Nano World Models, a minimalist codebase for future video prediction centered around diffusion forcing. Nano World Models provides a unified interface for generative objectives, model scales, action-conditioning mechanisms, latent observation spaces, datasets, evaluation protocols, and long-horizon rollout procedures.
